ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 52 · daily cycle day 22).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a low. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: A normal mid-cycle dip below the 10-day average — the real cycle low isn't due for ~14+ trading days. Wait for support to hold, or for the next low to set up.
entry.text_zh: 这是跌破 10 日均线的正常周期中段回调——真正的周期低点要到约 14+ 个交易日后才会到来。等待支撑站稳，或等下一个低点构筑成形。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 22 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 22 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 52 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 52 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量刚刚向下交叉；3 日线向下交叉；投资者周期已逾期（投资者周期第 52 周 · 日线周期第 22 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近低点。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A LOW signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-17), switching from UPTREND. Signal strength: faint (score +10/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近低点信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-17），自上涨趋势切换而来。 信号强度：微弱（评分 +10/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: light buy setting up (+26)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱买入构筑中（+26）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Ross Stores, Inc., operating under the brand name Ross Dress for Less, is an American chain of discount department stores headquartered in Dublin, California. It is the largest off-price retailer in the U.S.; as of July 2024, Ross operates 1,795 stores in 43 U.S.
profile.description_zh: Ross Stores, Inc. 以品牌名Ross Dress for Less运营，是美国一家折扣百货连锁店，总部位于加利福尼亚州都柏林。它是美国最大的折扣零售商；截至2024年7月，Ross在美国43个州运营1795家门店。

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.14 ± 0.15 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLY) reads duration-neutral (+0.05). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.14 ± 0.15——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLY）为久期中性（+0.05）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
